content.text: Akali mende koo pinya lao kunji pyaraminyi dupwa yaki nyuo
Satanena yulu pirami dokona mana koo nyii nao
Anatu kando giyalya giyana pyuo lenge dupwana role pyao kara nao piramo
akalinde ramo doko rae maiyuo pyakalyuo pyao karara ingilyamo.
Yulu koo pingi kandale doko suu pyao alowa pyuo banya rae maingi dokome Kamongona Mawa Pii lasi singi dokona warombo soo
yuu peparae kukwa korakamape yaka lao poraiyuo suu pingi.
Akali doko baa isa ipwa epo penge repeta ando karenge dopale doko.
Yuu gii jingi mondo lao lyingi yuu gii dokopa keyange pyuo lyingi.
Dee banya yoko dupwa yando naa nange.
Akali dokona yulu suu pingipi peparae kapa palyuo penge.
Akali koo pingi dupwa dopale ingya nange.
Yangi porambaiyeme poo lanyi nembenge dopale ingyuo penge.
Akali koo pingi dupwa Anatumi kote lao randa maira.
Koo pingi dupwa yulu rolae pingi dupwa pipya mendare ingya nara.
Kamongome rolae pingi dupwa kyawa minyuo kata lasaka pyuo karamo.
Dopa pyuo karapyamopape koo pingi dupwa koo dokona kimbu malyaro karaminyi.
